name: self-learning
description: The self-learning system shared by every automated loop in this repo. SubagentStop/SessionEnd hooks capture proto-learnings — raw observations worth improving — as rows on a shared Slack canvas (not GitHub issues, which silently lose captures across an org boundary). The hooks fire for any loop, matching on shared conventions (github-ops, /goal) rather than naming individual loops, so a new loop needs no integration here. Bundles two separate skills: proto-learning-capture (reference for the capture half and its row schema) and triage-learnings (Loop B), which weekly dedupes/clusters the canvas inbox and routes each cluster to a tracked issue on the owning MCP repo, a gated PR to the shared umbraco-mcp-skills, or a loop-improvement issue on this repo. Install alongside any loop plugin to get capture for free.
